scope.engine: Board + policy6 + ElementalShell121 + actual CompanionBattleAction six families
scope.campaign: U1-U400 configured; report actual coverage separately; transfer U401/U573/U721/U1000 without any cue
scope.delivered: Immediate exact blocked-cause feedback3200ms; native key/lock inspection and gate/free-piece previews are not simulated
scope.experimental: After-repeat and fading assistance; information/execution/mixed fully loaned teams. Loaned access bypasses ownership, not skill energy or one-use constraints.
scope.cueMechanism: Only a displayed last-error rule is recognized with certainty on that decision; initial knowledge and learning rates identical. Recognition/comprehension probability remains an uncalibrated hypothesis. No next-move solver cue added.
scope.solverBoundary: Only existing native U1/Focus and explicitly activated GUIDE/TRAIL/PULSE/FLOW receive native certified assistance. Hidden continuations never enter the bounded policy/search.
exclusions: No rendered UI, motor behavior or actual cognitive/emotional measurements
No ownership/acquisition/evolution/home navigation, IAP, ads or social acquisition
Behavioral utility coefficients unchanged and uncalibrated; no human retention claim

experimentalFork.interventionScope: campaign and held-out transfer; tactical already shell-free

metricDefinitions.completionRate: Mean trajectory completed/started attempts, including horizon-censored starts; not campaign completion
metricDefinitions.blockedRate: Mean trajectory blocked/all decisions; shell, talent, Undo and Focus interactions remain in denominator
metricDefinitions.modeledD1: Formula-generated active-session indicator on day1, not human retention
metricDefinitions.modeledD7: Formula-generated active-session indicator on day7, not human retention
metricDefinitions.meanSessionMinutes: Mean per-trajectory session duration in modeled minutes
metricDefinitions.meanOverrunMinutes: Mean per-trajectory max(0, session-planned) in modeled minutes
metricDefinitions.horizonCensored: Started attempt unfinished after8 modeled days, not a failure
metricDefinitions.manualExits: Successful directly tapped exits; not automated by talents
metricDefinitions.automatedExits: Actual PULSE/FLOW/resonance exits; separated from manual performance
metricDefinitions.repeatedErrors: Second and later blocks for identical present-mask/gates/piece/reason within one attempt
metricDefinitions.stopReasons: Final actual reason per modeled day; nonterminal attempt exhaustion no longer overwrites later cap termination

profiles.generation: Same independent Latin-hypercube generation as1.21; not human normed

transferWithoutCues.design: Only final learned rule states transplanted; reset fatigue/frustration/memory, equal180 coins; all coach, dead-end, Focus, companion and causal cues disabled. Different campaign exposure is retained, so this is training-regime transfer, not a pure cue-learning causal effect.

tacticalChapter.scope: Separate four-stage native chapter, one attempt per selected stage; no shell/coin/session-energy or return utility; route seeds identical across capacities/policies; fixed loan team nova/hoot/orbit. Charge and one-use talents persist across boards, no recharge. Capacities4/8 and spending policies are experimental; native default6.
tacticalChapter.cues: Immediate blocked cause3200ms and native dead-end warning; all solution information only via explicit GUIDE/FLOW/resonance native action. No Focus chain or campaign coach.

policies.manual: Never activate talents; same visible engine feedback
policies.early: Same bounded skill request policy as campaign; available from first board
policies.reserve_last_two: Decline talents on boards1/2, allow same request policy on boards3/4

traces.selection: First4 profiles repetition0; max80/scenario; nonrepresentative; exhaustive blocked events in separate CSV
